entry_item.definition: a) v.t. To lose; to let go, drop; to lose control of, be unable to control; to do something by mistake or by accident, make a slip.b) When preceded by modal converb, it signifies an action which almost happened.

example.definition: To make a slip of the tongue.
To take an oath, make a promise.
To lose one's life, die.
To lose time, miss one's chance or the right time.
To lose one's ability to work.
To become pale or lean; to look unwell.
To give a scream or shout.
To catch fire because of neglect; for a fire to spread or get out of control.
To lose one's grip on, lose control of
To be unable to keep from laughing; to burst into laughter.
To run or flee in panic
To lose ground; to slip; to be panicky.
To sweat profusely.
To lose or miss one's way, go astray.
To shed tears.
To lose sleep, suffer from insomnia.
To lose one's discretion; to misbehave, be naughty.
To lose the rule of a state.
To lose by theft or robbery.
To lose courage; to be undecided, hesitant.
[He, etc.] almost killed.
[He,' etc.] almost fell.
